# GRACEON repository-wide instructions

- Read `.github/skills/graceon-project/SKILL.md` before project changes.
- For visual/interface work, load and follow `.github/skills/ui-ux-pro-max/SKILL.md`.
- For verification/review, use `.github/skills/frontend-review/SKILL.md`; for accessibility concerns use `.github/skills/accessibility-check/SKILL.md`.
- Inspect before editing. Preserve existing functionality and project stack unless approved.
- Avoid fake data presented as real, repeated imagery, generic template design, dead controls, and unverified deployment claims.
- Run `npm run build` and report its actual result after code changes.
